svg.title: Japan at a glance
svg.desc: A static editorial infographic about Japan with a stylized map, nominal GDP bar chart, population composition donut chart, and travel highlights.
svg.text: EAST ASIA · ISLAND COUNTRY · DATA PROFILE

text.tspan: Japan arcs along the Pacific edge of East Asia,
where mountain ranges divide coastal plains and
shape distinct regional climates. Dense megacities,
precision industry, and high-speed rail sit alongside
temple towns, forests, hot springs, and volcanic coasts.
From snowy Hokkaido and the Japan Alps to the Tokyo–Osaka urban corridor and subtropical
southern islands, Japan compresses striking geographic variety into a rail-connected archipelago.
Nominal GDP stayed close to US$5 trillion
dollar terms as the yen weakened. The series
changes in output and domestic prices.

svg.text: Annual values, rounded to two decimals · zero-based scale
Share of total population · broad nationality / ethnic grouping
Percentages rounded to one decimal · total shown equals 100%

svg.text: GDP and population values supplied in the brief. GDP is nominal, current US$ trillions. Map is stylized, city positions approximate, and destination notes are concise editorial summaries.
